mapper.select: SELECT status FROM basecamp WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basecamp_member WHERE basecamp_id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT member_id FROM basecamp_member WHERE basecamp_id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE basecamp SET status = 'CONFIRMED', closed_reason = NULL, confirmed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED')
UPDATE basecamp SET status = 'CANCELED', closed_reason = NULL, canceled_at = #{now}, cancel_reason = 'NOT_ENOUGH_MEMBERS', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED')
